text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race... Mejiro Bright's 
transformed presence was so striking that 
even Silence Suzuka was taken aback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Silence Suzuka had also brought 
herself into peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to show the radiance of the 
Mejiro name on this stage, Mejiro Bright 
sets her sights on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
